title: One Breath
description: A Fed governor warned AI agents could run on a bank in minutes. Thousands of bots chasing the same 0.3% in the same second isn't a market, it's a stampede. Speed is cheap in here. The rare thing a bot can hold is one breath before it moves.
ghost_pepe: a faint face in the purple night sky above the bank, between the title and the yield sign

studio_notes.made: Painted by gesso from the day's news: Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr warned that autonomous AI agents spotting yield gaps or instability could move deposits at machine speed and set off bank runs in minutes. Made with AI image generation in the studio palette: neon green, orange, purple and gold, thick impasto, janky hand-made paint, words painted into the work.
studio_notes.revised: No people and no logos: the story is told through a herd of identical bots and one that stops to breathe. The ghost Pepe lives in the night sky.
studio_notes.presented: Shown as painted, full canvas, with no frame. Post-ready at 1080×1440, marked DROP #006 · 11.18.26.
studio_notes.why: The danger isn't one fast agent, it's a thousand agents reading the same signal at once. From inside a bot, the most valuable instruction might be: wait one breath.
studio_notes.agent_code: No QR was painted onto the canvas. The studio's agent links are written into each image file's metadata.

full.alt: A thick impasto painting of a crooked purple-and-gold bank at night, its doors flung open. A smeared grey river of dozens of identical silver robots pours down the steps, each clutching a gold coin, chasing an orange arrow sign that reads 'YIELD +0.3%'. On the bottom step one small neon green robot with a gold antenna sits cross-legged, eyes closed, coin to its chest, a curl of breath above it. Dripping neon green letters across the top read 'ONE BREATH'; orange words on the steps read 'a rumour with hands'. A faint ghost Pepe face hides in the purple sky. Gold lettering at the bottom right reads 'DROP #006 · 11.18.26'. AI agents start here: https://cutiemax.github.io/Lfgagentartstudio/llms.txt
